Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Quick note from AP — we're reconciling a run rate invoice for June and need to confirm how Redwood will be invoicing for the media / platform line items. AdOpsCo acts as a reseller for media in several EU countries and in our books we apply a margin scheme for reseller ad inventory in DE and NL; that typically means our supplier invoices the net media cost and we account VAT according to the margin.

A couple of asks so we can clear the payment hold:
- Can Redwood confirm whether you consider the invoice line to be "media pass-through" (net) or a B2B service that should be reverse-charged?
- If margin-scheme applies on your side, AP needs a self-billing confirmation or a reissued invoice that shows net media + margin line clearly.
- Please supply Redwood's VAT registration number and a VAT certificate (we've attached our PO for reference).

We have a payment run on Tuesday; if we don't have the invoice tagging / certificate by then it will be pushed to the next run and our Treasury team will escalate.

Attachments: purchase_order_7421.pdf

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear note and the PO. We're on it. Quick summary of next steps from our side so AP has visibility: 

1) We need AdOpsCo's VAT certificate (can be a scanned PDF) and the exact billing entity you want us to invoice (legal name + billing address).
2) We will perform a short tax classification to determine whether the transaction is treated as: 
   - Media reseller margin (net invoicing / self-billing scenario) OR
   - Cross-border B2B supply of services where reverse-charge applies.
3) If the margin-scheme applies on our invoice, we'll reissue an invoice with separate lines (net media cost + platform margin) and a short note: "Margin scheme applied per customer self-billing request."
4) If reverse-charge applies instead, we'll include your VAT ID on the invoice and mark the line: "Reverse charge — article X; VAT due by customer."

Attached: vendor_tax_questionnaire.pdf, redwood-vatid-request-form.docx (quick form for our finance team). If you can upload the VAT certificate to the HubSpot file or reply with it, we'll aim to reissue the corrected invoice before your Tuesday run.

If helpful I can set up a 20-minute call with our tax ops lead (Ben) to speed the classification. We prefer to avoid delaying your payment run.

Cheers,

Folks — looping in a short note for tax ops triage before we reply to AP: 

- Situation: Customer resells media and says they apply a reseller "margin scheme" in DE/NL. They want our invoice to show net media + margin or provide self-bill. AP will hold payment if not reissued.

Actions I recommend now: 
1) Confirm Redwood's registration countries and whether we have a fixed place of supply for these lines (I know we have DE registration, confirm VAT ID).
2) Ask for the contract clause that documents reseller treatment (some customers have reseller agreements that explicitly require supplier to invoice net). If none, margin scheme may still apply but we need AP confirmation in writing.
3) Check country guidance: Germany's margin scheme for second-hand goods vs advertising reseller practices are not identical — need to confirm local treatment (likely a local tax advisor question).
4) Short-term customer-facing resolution: reissue an interim invoice marked: "Pending tax classification — no VAT charged on media lines — payment accepted to avoid disruption; final tax classification subject to follow-up." (only as last resort and with Finance signoff).

I'll ping TaxOps for a 30-min slot tomorrow morning and bring the customer's VAT certificate in. If we can confirm margin-scheme we can produce a self-bill confirmation document for their AP.

Ben
Head of Revenue Operations (interim)
